What is Duroode Ibrahim

The Duroode Ibrahim, also known as Salat al-Ibrahimiyyah, is a special prayer of blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his family, as well as Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and his family. Muslims widely recited it, especially in their daily prayers (Salah) after the Tashahhud. Here is the Durood Ibrahimi in Arabic along with its English transliteration and translation in Urdu and English:

Duroode Ibrahim Arabic

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ

Duroode Ibrahim Transliteration

Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammadin kama sallaita 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala aali Ibraheema innaka hameedum majeed. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Ibraheema wa 'ala aali Ibraheema innaka hameedum majeed.

Duroode Ibrahim Translation English

O Allah, send Your mercy upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent Your mercy upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Verily, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Verily, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

Duroode Ibrahim Translation Urdu:

اے اللہ! حضرت محمد (ﷺ) اور آل محمد پر رحمت نازل فرما جس طرح تو نے حضرت ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) اور آل ابراہیم پر رحمت نازل فرمائی۔ بے شک تو تعریف کے لائق اور بزرگی والا ہے۔

اے اللہ! حضرت محمد (ﷺ) اور آل محمد پر برکت نازل فرما جس طرح تو نے حضرت ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) اور آل ابراہیم پر برکت نازل فرمائی۔  بے شک تو تعریف کے لائق اور بزرگی والا ہے۔

Virtue and Significance of Duroode Ibrahhimi in the Quran

This Durood is a significant part of Islamic worship. It is often recited to seek blessings for the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his family, while also connecting the supplicant to the legacy of the Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham). The importance of sending blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is emphasized in the following verse of Surah Al Ahzab (33:56):
Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace.
This verse underscores the significance of reciting durood sharif upon the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The Duroode Ibrahimi is one of the most authentic and beloved forms of fulfilling this command. Reciting it is considered a means of gaining closeness to Allah, receiving His blessings, and following the example set by the Prophet himself.

Virtues of Reciting Durood Sharif

  • Fulfillment of Command: In the Quran, Allah tells us that He and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Allah also asks believers to do the same.
  • Increased Blessings: When we recite Durood it brings immense blessings from Allah (Barakah) into one's life.
  • Forgiveness of Sins: Reciting Duroode Pak is a means of seeking forgiveness for one's sins.
  • Elevating Status: It elevates the spiritual status of the person who recites it in the eyes of Allah.
  • Prophet's Intercession:  On the Day of Judgment, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) will speak in favor of those who used to send blessings upon him.

Hadith on Durood Sharif

There is a Hadith where the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) explained the importance of sending blessings (Durood) to him. Hadith
The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said, "Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him tenfold, erase ten sins from him, and raise him ten degrees in status. (Sahih Muslim, Book 4, Hadith 747).

Conclusion:

Durood Ibrahimi is a very special and important prayer for Muslims. It is a way to show love and respect for the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and to ask for Allah's blessings. By reciting it, we follow the command of Allah, gain blessings, and hope for the Prophet's intercession on the Day of Judgment.
